takeaway: False: the first rib does not move during respiration. Inspiration involves diaphragm descent, ribs moving up and out (larger AP dimension), and serratus anterior via the long thoracic nerve.

lines.text: Which statement about the movements of inspiration is false?
Inspiration involves descent of the diaphragm,
and elevation of the ribs, which move upwards and outwards, increasing the anteroposterior dimension of the chest.
Contraction of the intercostal muscles is part of it too.
The long thoracic nerve supplies serratus anterior, which helps lift the ribs.
But the first rib stays put: it does not move during respiration.
lines.say: (laugh) But the first rib stays put: it does not move during respiration.

lines.text: So the false statement is the upward and forward movement of the first rib.
